snippet.title: Generate UNLIMITED AI Images for FREE with Claude Code
snippet.description:
🎓 Full course — build real products with AI: 
https://learnwithhasan.com/courses/solo-builder-10/

Generate images with Claude Code, 100% free. I walk through all 3 levels, from
code-drawn PNGs to real AI images via Cloudflare's Flux (10,000 free every single
day), then reveal the exact skill pipeline that turns them into a full,
consistent-character storybook.

💻 GitHub repo (skills + code) 👇
https://github.com/hassancs91/claude-image-generation

⏱️ Timestamps
0:00 Generate images with Claude Code (for free)
0:11 The storybook demo — what you'll build by the end
1:04 The 3 levels of image generation
1:12 Level 1 — Code-driven images (logos, charts, PNGs)
1:55 Level 2 — 3D renders with Three.js
2:35 Level 3 — Real AI images, free via Cloudflare (Flux · 10,000/day)
3:34 The real power: combining skills into one pipeline
5:00 Free project, course & guides
